age.evidence: Upon arrival at the American University Animal Facility on postnatal day 32-35 ... Until training, subjects were allowed to mature undisturbed except for general husbandry and handling.

sex.evidence: Subjects were 40 experimentally naïve male Sprague-Dawley rats ... Subjects were experimentally naive male Sprague-Dawley rats (n = 40).

dosing.evidence: LSD was dissolved in sterile saline (0.9%) and administered intraperitoneally at a dose of 25, 50, 100, or 200 ug/kg at a concentration of 100 ug/ml ... repeated for a total of five complete cycles.
Fluoxetine hydrochloride ... was dissolved in sterile saline at a concentration of 5 mg/ml and administered subcutaneously at a dose of 10 mg/kg ... repeated for a total of five complete cycles.

handling.evidence: subjects were allowed to mature undisturbed except for general husbandry and handling during the lights-on phase of the light/dark trial to minimize stress during subsequent procedures

group_housing.evidence: they were housed in Optirat Plus cages (38.9 × 56.9 × 26.2 cm; 1,181 cm2 floor space) with two rats per cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-hr light-dark cycle with lights on between 08:00 and 20:00 hr

enrichment_housing.evidence: Housing described only as Optirat Plus cages with two rats per cage; no mention of enrichment items.

assays.assay_description: Rats received 20-min access to a novel 0.1% saccharin solution in individual hanging wire-mesh test cages (24.3 × 19 × 18 cm) with graduated Nalgene tubes; saccharin intake (ml) measured across repeated conditioning trials. Experiment 1: 5 conditioning trials with LSD 25, 50, 100, 200 µg/kg i.p. or vehicle. Experiment 2: after fluoxetine (10 mg/kg s.c.) or vehicle pre-exposure (5 injections every 4th day), 6 acquisition trials with LSD 50 µg/kg or vehicle, followed by 6 extinction trials with saccharin alone.

application_type.evidence: LSD was dissolved in sterile saline (0.9%) and administered intraperitoneally ... (fluoxetine pre-exposure was given subcutaneously)

setup_habituation.evidence: Following 24-hr water deprivation, animals were weighed and then placed in the test cages where they were given 20-min access to water. This procedure was repeated for 14 days (Exp 1) / 5 days (Exp 2).

setup_restrain.evidence: subjects were weighed, placed in the test cages, and given 20-min access to a novel saccharin solution; no restraint described

food_restriction.evidence: they were maintained on ad libitum food and 20-min daily access to fluids; no food was present in the test cages during the 20-min fluid sessions

water_restriction.evidence: Following 24-hr water deprivation, animals were weighed and then placed in the test cages ... subjects were deprived of water for 23⅔ hr

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately following saccharin access, animals were ... injected; this procedure of a conditioning trial followed by 3 water-recovery days was repeated, so each subsequent saccharin session occurred ~4 days after the previous LSD injection; extinction trials occurred weeks after the last injection.

sample_size.evidence: divided into five groups (n = 8 per group) [Experiment 1]; Groups VV, FV, VL, and FL (n = 10 per group) [Experiment 2]

outcomes.summary: LSD produced dose-dependent conditioned taste avoidance of saccharin, with near-complete suppression at 100 and 200 µg/kg and intermediate suppression at 25 and 50 µg/kg (Experiment 1). In Experiment 2, fluoxetine pre-exposure (10 mg/kg, five injections) had no significant overall effect on acquisition or extinction of avoidance induced by 50 µg/kg LSD, although subgroup analyses of animals drinking below their group mean suggested attenuated avoidance in fluoxetine-pretreated rats.
outcomes.statistics: Exp 1: dose F(4,35)=16.304, p<.001; trial F(4,140)=70.020, p<.001; Dose × Trial F(16,140)=14.135, p<.001. Exp 2 acquisition: conditioning drug F(1,36)=89.382, p<.001; trial F(5,180)=11.117, p<.001; Drug × Trial F(5,180)=40.398, p<.001; no effect of pre-exposure (all ps>.05). Exp 2 extinction: F(1,36)=44.594, p<.001; F(5,180)=38.517, p<.001; F(5,180)=22.675, p<.001; no effect of pre-exposure (all ps>.05).
outcomes.evidence: LSD induced dose-dependent taste avoidance ... There was no effect of pre-exposure alone or in interaction with any other factor (all ps > .05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: A 5 × 5 mixed model analysis of variance (ANOVA) was run on consumption of saccharin ... water consumption on water-recovery sessions remained high throughout the study.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total 20-min consumption per session is reported; trial-to-trial changes are between-session comparisons, not within-session dynamics.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions, sequences, or bout microstructure reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only fluid consumption volume (ml) was measured; no natural behaviours scored as distinct acts.

B5_social.evidence: conducted in individual hanging stainless-steel, wire-mesh test cages

B6_cognitive.evidence: animals come to avoid consumption of the drug-associated solution, indexing aversive effects of the drug examined (Pavlovian taste avoidance learning).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Total water consumption was calculated by subtracting pre- from postconsumption volumes.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Mixed model ANOVAs on saccharin consumption only; no dimensionality reduction or multivariate behavioural analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: conducted in individual hanging stainless-steel, wire-mesh test cages measuring 24.3 × 19 × 18 cm

E2_shelter.evidence: Wire-mesh test cage with a fluid tube; no enclosed refuge described.

E3_bedding.evidence: individual hanging stainless-steel, wire-mesh test cages (no bedding/substrate)

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the test cages.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the test cages.

E6_spatial.evidence: test cages measuring 24.3 × 19 × 18 cm; single undivided compartment

E7_social_context.evidence: conducted in individual hanging stainless-steel, wire-mesh test cages

E8_food_water.evidence: Fifty-ml graduated Nalgene tubes were positioned on the front of each cage for fluid access; subjects were given 20-min access to a novel saccharin solution during the recording session.

D1_continuity.evidence: This procedure of a conditioning trial followed by 3 water-recovery days was repeated for a total of five complete cycles (20 days) ... six complete extinction cycles.

D2_session_duration.evidence: given 20-min access to a novel saccharin solution

D3_recording_days.evidence: Experiment 1: five conditioning (saccharin) trials; Experiment 2: six acquisition trials plus six extinction trials, in addition to water habituation sessions in the same cages.

D4_baseline.evidence: On the day following water habituation, subjects were ... given 20-min access to a novel saccharin solution. Immediately following saccharin access, animals were ranked on saccharin consumption (Trial 1 consumption recorded prior to any injection).

D5_followup.evidence: On the final conditioning day (Trial 5), subjects were given 20-min access to saccharin but were not injected ... extinction phase commenced with no injections given.

D6_circadian.evidence: All recording sessions were 20 min; none spanned ≥6 hr.

judge_notes: All candidates agreed there is a single behavioural paradigm; Experiment 1 (LSD dose-response) and Experiment 2 (fluoxetine pre-exposure, acquisition + extinction) were merged into ONE conditioned taste avoidance assay per the rubric (same apparatus/protocol; different doses, pre-treatments and learning phases).
B1: set to 1 (2-3 measures) — saccharin consumption plus water consumption on recovery sessions are both reported behavioural variables; body weight is physiological and excluded.
B2: overrode gemma4's 'Yes' — trial-to-trial changes are between-session comparisons, not within-session temporal dynamics.
E8: scored 1 (overriding gemma4) — the saccharin/water tube is physically accessible inside the test cage during the recorded 20-min session.
D2: 20-min session falls in the 15–60 min bin → score 1 (gemma4's score of 0 contradicted its own evidence).
D5: scored 1 — non-injected final conditioning trial and six extinction trials occurred ≥24 h after the last LSD injection.
application_type set to i.p. (route of the psychedelic, LSD); fluoxetine s.c. noted in evidence rather than coding 'multiple'.
time_to_assay set to 'multiple': the recorded saccharin session precedes injection on Trial 1, while later trials/extinction occur days to weeks after the last LSD dose.
Fluoxetine added as a second dosing entry per rubric instruction to capture every compound administered.
